title_en: Understand the care entry points
title_zh: 理解不同就医入口
body_en: Review official descriptions of primary care, walk-in care, and emergency departments. These labels describe services; this guide does not choose a care level from symptoms.
body_zh: 查看官方对 primary care、walk-in care 和 emergency department 的说明。本指南解释服务类型，不根据症状判断应去哪类机构。

title_en: Ask a healthcare professional when unsure
title_zh: 不确定时咨询医疗人员
body_en: McKinley lists a 24/7 nurse phone service at 217-333-2700. Ask whether you are eligible to use it.
body_zh: McKinley 公布了 24/7 护士电话服务：217-333-2700。请确认自己是否有资格使用。

title_en: Start with your existing follow-up instructions
title_zh: 先查看已有复诊要求
body_en: Use the follow-up instructions from your treating clinician. Contact that team to clarify the next visit and which specialist to contact. This guide does not set a treatment timetable.
body_zh: 先查看治疗医生提供的 follow-up instructions；向原治疗团队确认下一次就诊和应联系的专科。本指南不设定治疗或复诊时间。

title_en: Separate the campus health fee from insurance
title_zh: 区分校内健康服务费与保险
body_en: McKinley services use the Health Service Fee, with exclusions. The fee does not pay for outside care, including referrals; ask about campus eligibility and any separate charges.
body_zh: McKinley 服务使用 Health Service Fee，但有除外项目。该费用不支付校外就医，包括转诊；请确认校内服务资格及额外收费。

title_en: Identify your exact insurance plan
title_zh: 确认具体保险计划
body_en: Use your insurance documents or contact your insurer to identify the plan and its provider directory. An insurer name alone is not enough to confirm a provider network.
body_zh: 查看保险文件或联系保险公司，确认具体 plan 及 provider directory。仅知道保险公司名称，不足以确认医生属于哪个网络。

title_en: Ask how to obtain insurance documentation
title_zh: 询问如何取得保险凭证
body_en: Contact your insurer about your insurance documentation before the appointment. Ask the office which documentation it accepts.
body_zh: 预约前向保险公司询问保险凭证，并向诊所确认接受哪些证明。

title_en: Check the provider, location, and plan together
title_zh: 同时核实医生、地点和保险计划
body_en: Check your plan directory and confirm with the insurer and office. Ask about the named clinician and visit location. Network participation is separate from coverage of a particular service.
body_zh: 查看计划目录，并向保险公司和诊所确认具体医生与就诊地点。属于网络内，不等于某项服务一定获得 coverage。

title_en: Ask whether a referral is needed
title_zh: 确认是否需要转诊单
body_en: Ask the insurer and specialist office whether this visit requires a referral. A referral is an order to see a specialist or receive certain services; requirements vary.
body_zh: 向保险公司与专科诊所确认这次就诊是否需要 referral。Referral 是转诊至专科或某些服务的医嘱；要求会因情况而异。

title_en: Use McKinley referral support when applicable
title_zh: 符合条件时使用 McKinley 转诊支持
body_en: If your McKinley provider recommends an outside referral, its Referral Specialist can help with the process, network questions, and forms.
body_zh: 如果 McKinley 医生建议校外转诊，其 Referral Specialist 可以协助转诊流程、网络问题及表格。

title_en: Ask about prior authorization for planned services
title_zh: 询问计划中的服务是否需要预授权
body_en: For planned services, ask whether prior authorization is required and who submits it. Preauthorization is not a promise that the plan will cover the cost.
body_zh: 对于计划中的服务，询问是否需要 prior authorization，以及由谁申请。获得预授权不代表保险一定支付费用。

title_en: Ask what costs remain your responsibility
title_zh: 确认需要自付的费用
body_en: Ask your insurer how the deductible and other cost sharing apply to the planned visit. This project does not estimate a final bill.
body_zh: 向保险公司询问 deductible 和其他费用分担如何适用于这次就诊。本项目不估算最终账单。

title_en: Use the official McKinley appointment entry
title_zh: 使用 McKinley 官方预约入口
body_en: Most appointments can be scheduled through MyMcKinley or by calling 217-333-2700. Confirm the visit type with the office.
body_zh: 多数预约可以通过 MyMcKinley 或拨打 217-333-2700 完成。向办公室确认就诊类型。

title_en: Confirm the booking route and availability
title_zh: 确认预约方式和是否接诊
body_en: Use the official care entry or office contact. Say whether you are a new patient and explain the visit purpose. Ask whether that visit type can be booked online.
body_zh: 使用官方就医入口或联系办公室。说明是否为新患者以及就诊目的；确认该类就诊是否能在线预约。

title_en: Check the advertised walk-in services
title_zh: 查看公布的 walk-in 服务
body_en: Carle describes Convenient Care as walk-in care and lists extra diagnostics for Convenient Care Plus. Confirm the exact location and services before relying on a specific test.
body_zh: Carle 将 Convenient Care 说明为 walk-in 门诊，并列出 Convenient Care Plus 的额外检查服务。需要具体检查时，先确认地点与服务。

title_en: Request an interpreter ahead of time
title_zh: 提前询问口译支持
body_en: Call the office before the visit to request an interpreter. Confirm arrangements; this project does not assume every location has the same language services.
body_zh: 就诊前联系办公室申请 interpreter，并确认安排。本项目不假设每个地点提供相同的语言服务。

title_en: Ask how to transfer existing records
title_zh: 询问如何提交已有病历
body_en: Ask the receiving office which existing records it needs and how to send them. McKinley uses an authorization process for record requests; allow time for processing.
body_zh: 向接收诊所确认需要哪些已有病历及提交方式。McKinley 申请病历需要授权流程，应留出处理时间。

title_en: Ask the original provider about records
title_zh: 向原就诊机构询问病历
body_en: Ask the office that treated you how to obtain your records, and ask the follow-up office which records are needed. Do not upload personal medical records to this repository.
body_zh: 向原治疗机构询问如何取得病历，再向复诊办公室确认需要哪些资料。不要将个人病历上传到本仓库。

title_en: Prepare identification and visit documents
title_zh: 准备身份与就诊文件
body_en: Bring available insurance documentation, photo identification, and any requested forms. Ask the office about payment requirements.
body_zh: 准备已有保险凭证、带照片的身份证明及诊所要求的表格，并确认付款要求。

title_en: Prepare medication and allergy information
title_zh: 准备用药与过敏信息
body_en: Make a list of medicines, supplements, allergies, and questions. Keep the list with you rather than entering personal medical details into this demo.
body_zh: 整理药物、补充剂、过敏情况和问题清单。自行携带，不需要在本演示中输入个人医疗详情。

title_en: Write down questions and take notes
title_zh: 写下问题并记录回答
body_en: Prepare the questions you want to discuss. During the visit, take notes and ask for clarification when an explanation is unclear.
body_zh: 提前写下想讨论的问题；就诊时记录回答，听不明白时要求解释。

title_en: Check the cancellation policy
title_zh: 查看取消预约要求
body_en: McKinley publishes a two-hour cancellation deadline and a missed-appointment charge. Recheck the current policy when booking; other offices may use different rules.
body_zh: McKinley 公布了提前两小时取消的要求及未按时取消的费用。预约时重新确认当前规定；其他诊所规则可能不同。

title_en: Confirm what happens after the visit
title_zh: 确认就诊后的下一步
body_en: Ask for written next steps, the timing of any follow-up, and whom to contact with questions. Follow the treating clinician's instructions.
body_zh: 询问书面的后续步骤、复诊安排，以及有问题时联系谁；遵循治疗医生的要求。
